--- claude
argv: -p --model model-a
HARNESS_TICK=state=H/state slot=1 agent=claude model=model-a kind=work
TICK_AGENT=claude
claude model-a work
1 claude model-a work
claude: five_hour=10% weekly=20% stop=88% long_stop=88% ceiling=90%: go on
--- codex

TICK_AGENT=claude
codex model-x work
1 codex model-x work
codex: primary=30% stop=88% long_stop=88% ceiling=90%: go on
